title: Skimmer
summary: SKIM'MER, noun 1. An utensil in the form of a scoop; used for skimming liquors. 2. One that skims over a subject. 3. A sea fowl, the cut-water.

inlines.v: SKIM'MER, noun 1. An utensil in the form of a scoop; used for skimming liquors. 2. One that skims over a subject. 3. A sea fowl, the cut-water.
